name: Tariro Mukute
desc: Tariro is a PhD candidate in the Intelligent Connectivity Group, researching a dynamic and autonomous 5G N6-LAN: the network between the 5G core and the internet, where operators chain services such as content filters, intrusion prevention and caches. Tariro's work makes these service function chains policy-driven and changeable at run time. Tariro is also a Senior 5G Researcher at phine.tech in Vienna and a maintainer of the OpenAirInterface (OAI) 5G Core Network.
